segments.text: We turn now to 1 John chapter 5 and verse 1.
Whoever believes that Jesus is the Christ, that is the Messiah, is born of God, and whoever
loves the Father loves the child born of Him.
By this we know that we love the children of God, when we love God and observe His
commandments.
For this is the love of God that we keep His commandments, and His commandments are not
burdensome.
Now in our study through the first letter of John, we have repeatedly seen how John places
the emphasis on these two matters, obedience to God's commandments and loving God's children,
as the two essential tests of life of a genuine faith in Jesus.

chapters John keeps coming back to these two subjects.
When we studied chapter 2, we saw how John speaks about these two things in chapter

loving one another.

perfected in love is again these two things, keeping God's commandments and loving God's
children.

manifestations in our life, obedience to God's commandments and loving God's children.
When we studied chapter 1, we saw how John speaks about fellowship in two directions.

plane among God's children.

Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, strength, soul and mind.

other.

commandments.
